payload.text: Every install hint in the vendored runtime that names Homebrew also names a way to install the tool on Linux that puts it on PATH: a Linux package manager where Ubuntu's archive carries it, and for swift-format, which no Ubuntu package puts on PATH, the Swift toolchain (swift.org/install); held by a scan of lib/ whose accepted spellings are declared in its arm (vc's ruling of 2026-10-16 on dc's measurement).
